changes: Fix the TTL Fix quietly losing its rules after a power cycle or a firewall reload while still reading as enabled, which left no internet until it was switched off and on by hand.
The IP option netfilter targets now ship in the image, so a hand-written iptables -j TTL --ttl-set rule works without installing anything first.
Fix Xray's VPN rules breaking the LAN's DNS and TCP after a reboot when the tunnel was not actually running; they are now installed only while Xray is really up and listening.
Fix the Messages page showing "could not be refreshed" when an SMS arrives into an otherwise empty inbox; a message still being read is now shown as arriving, not as a failure.
Fix the APN reconciler forcing a previous SIM's APN onto a different SIM; only a genuine APN or auth mismatch is corrected now, and at most once every ten minutes.
Add a "Restart modem" button (Overview > Control) that parks and re-enables the radio for about 10 seconds, for when a settings change otherwise needs a full power cycle.
Xray's status page no longer re-runs the 34 MB binary just to read its version, which on this board could exhaust RAM alongside Xray's own startup.
